authority.design_baseline_name: v0.3.0-proposal1 integration over approved Gallery foundation
authority.change_policy: Package definitions take precedence where present; existing definitions survive only where absent. The earlier a8 baseline remains historical evidence. Integration is not a release or blanket native-component acceptance.

specs.classification: Package specifications take precedence. Existing implementation-specific fixtures below remain only as a nonconflicting supplement.

calibration_layout.policy: Proposal layout takes precedence for current captures; preserve the original three calibration pages and the scrolling fixture.

typography_policy.rust_role_binding: See design/source/rust-mapping.json. Retain existing roles only when the proposal has no exact semantic equivalent.
typography_policy.font_policy: Use platform UI and monospace fonts; do not redistribute system fonts.

components.policy: Use current proposal tokens and contracts for overlapping semantics; retain only nonconflicting fixture behavior.

navigation.selection_changes_update: Scene, title and menu check state only when actual state changes.
navigation.search: Not part of the approved three-page baseline; future additions must preserve existing appearance.

redraw_policy: Hover entering or leaving a row can redraw.
Pointer movement within one row and repeated selection of the same item do not redraw.
interaction.static_text_pickers: Mouse fixture/width selection; invalid width falls back to fixture default.

motion.implementation_status: Existing auto-scroll fixture retained. Proposal interaction contracts are requirements, not a claim that all native behavior is implemented.

implemented_contracts: Theme selection and follow-system appearance/contrast semantics.
Explicit five-state visual samples in the verification page.
accessibility.policy: Visual sample or token coverage does not prove accessible control behavior.

evidence.matrix: Original three pages x four themes x two scales.
evidence.golden_policy: Approved immutable evidence; updates require explicit visual review and user approval.
limits: No private comparison images in the public golden directory.
CI metadata/source checks do not prove same-environment pixel acceptance.
A candidate must have independent actual build/source provenance.

Proposal static reports are imported evidence only; current integration/native checks are recorded independently. Earlier goldens are historical and are not overwritten to hide intentional proposal changes.

known_gaps.detail: The frozen Gallery and token vocabulary are not a complete production component library or icon system.
Keep original F1 mixed scrolling gate failure; this export does not change that result.
Physical no-dropped-frame behavior and 60-second idle CPU remain unverified.
Current rendering/font evidence is macOS-specific; other platforms have not been accepted.

known_gaps.note: 40 component contracts and 10 recipes are stored and indexed. Contract presence does not mean a finished Rust implementation or native acceptance.

token_source.value_authority: Authoritative base tokens, explicit consumer BrandConfig and brand policy, retained legacy supplement, and Rust API mapping; tokens.json is generated and must not be hand-edited.
token_source.unit_policy: Logical pt is retained in this project schema. No CSS px/rem conversion is implied.
token_source.format_policy: Project-owned schema using DTCG-inspired $type/$value spelling; not full DTCG compliance.
token_source.single_source_migration: Design inputs compile into a merged JSON projection; normal Cargo build verifies freshness and generates OUT_DIR Rust tokens. Python tools are development-time tools; native Gallery remains pure Rust.
